tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
TJ Box/ Fiber Joint Box 8 Port

The 8 Port TV-8 FTTH Tray Outdoor TJ Fiber Joint Box is a high-quality fiber optic terminal joint box designed for secure and efficient fiber cable management. Built to support FTTH (Fiber to the Home) applications, this 8-way fiber joint box is ideal for telecommunication networks, broadband systems, and data centers, ensuring reliable and stable fiber connectivity. With its IP65-rated protection, the TV-8 Fiber Joint Box is dustproof and water-resistant, making it suitable for outdoor installations. It effectively shields fiber connections from environmental factors such as dust, rain, and moisture, ensuring long-lasting performance in harsh conditions. The durable black housing is designed to withstand extreme weather conditions, providing superior protection for fiber splicing and distribution. Equipped with 8 fiber optic ports, this joint box allows for easy cable routing, minimizing clutter and simplifying network organization. It features an FTTH tray inside, which helps in proper fiber management and splicing, making installation smooth and efficient. Additionally, the built-in PLC Splitter Slot enhances flexibility, allowing users to integrate splitters for optimized signal distribution. To further enhance protection, the TV-8 FTTH Fiber Joint Box comes with rubber cap protectors, safeguarding fiber ports from external damage and contamination. Its compact and lightweight design allows for easy wall or pole mounting, making it perfect for outdoor fiber optic network setups. This 8-port fiber joint box is an ideal solution for fiber network expansion, providing secure, efficient, and reliable connectivity. Whether used in residential, commercial, or industrial applications, it ensures seamless fiber optic connections with superior protection and durability.

Features of 8 Port TV-8 FTTH Tray Outdoor TJ Fiber Joint Box

  • 8-Way Fiber Joint Box – Designed for efficient fiber cable splicing and management, ensuring stable and secure connections.
  • IP65 Protection – Dustproof and water-resistant, providing reliable performance in outdoor environments.
  • FTTH Tray Inside – Built-in fiber tray for organized fiber splicing and cable management.
  • PLC Splitter Slot – Supports PLC splitters for signal distribution and network expansion.
  • Rubber Cap Protector – Protects fiber ports from dust, moisture, and damage, ensuring long-term performance.
  • Outdoor Application – Designed for FTTH, broadband, and telecom networks, suitable for harsh weather conditions.
  • Durable Construction – Made with high-quality materials, ensuring long-lasting protection and reliability.
  • Easy Cable Routing – Features 8 fiber optic ports, allowing for smooth and hassle-free cable management.
  • Compact and Lightweight – Sleek black design with wall or pole mounting options for flexible installation.
